title: It moved
setting: Two travelers at an airport gate. A change has just been announced.
situationZh: 机场登机口。刚广播说航班换了门。两个旅客在确认。

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Wait, is this still going to Boston?
lines.spoken: Wait, is this still going to Boston?
lines.meaningZh: 等一下，这班还是去波士顿的吗？

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I don't think so. They just said it moved to gate C40.
lines.spoken: I don't think so. They just said it moved to gate C40.
lines.meaningZh: 应该不是。他们刚说换到 C40 登机口了。

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: C40? That's all the way down.
lines.spoken: C40? That's all the way down.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Yeah. And we board in like twenty minutes.
lines.spoken: Yeah. And we board in like twenty minutes.
lines.meaningZh: 对。而且大概二十分钟后就开始登机。

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Of course we do. You wanna just start walking?
lines.spoken: Of course we do. You wanna just start walking?
lines.meaningZh: 当然是这样。要不要现在就走？

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: We should. I'll check the board one more time.
lines.spoken: We should. I'll check the board one more time.
lines.meaningZh: 该走了。我再看一眼屏幕。

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: C40, on time. We should be good if we go now.
lines.spoken: C40, on time. We should be good if we go now.
lines.meaningZh: C40，准点。现在走应该来得及。

gist.askEn: What do they decide to do?

details.askEn: Is the flight still on time?

glue.noteZh: wanna just start 连在一起，just 的 t 几乎丢掉，中间像一长串滑音。
glue.standard: you want to just start walking

glue.span: we should be good if we go now
glue.hear: we should be good if we go now
glue.noteZh: should be good 是口语里「应该没问题」，be 很弱，if we go now 会收得很紧。
glue.standard: we should be good if we go now

chunks.sayAfter: They just said it moved to gate C40.
You wanna just start walking? We board soon.

chunks.form: We should be good if we go now.
chunks.sayAfter: We should be good if we go now.

roleplay.setupZh: 你在机场，刚听到航班换了登机口。你想确认是不是还去原定城市，并决定要不要现在走过去。
roleplay.aiRole: Maya, a fellow traveler who heard the announcement. Helpful, a little hurried, not panicked.
variants: The new gate is not on the board yet.
It's a different city, not Boston.
starters: Wait, is this still going to Boston?

fluency.promptZh: 用自己的话讲刚才登机口换了、你们怎么确认、后来怎么决定的。准备 15 秒，然后说 60 秒，再更短、更快地说两遍。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the story of the gate change and what you decided to do. Prep 15 seconds, then speak for 60, then 45, then 30.
